alex: Heads-up: intermittent tail spikes in apac-edge racks (rack-a7) since 01:22; looks like allocator is doing aggressive backfill when a noisy tenant drops bursts. 95th up ~150ms. anyone on watch?

brynn: seeing it. pattern: small allocation storms followed by kvcache evictions. Mostly affects shared pools, but some dedicated-slice latency blips too.

chen: could be the new soft-backfill policy (commit b9a1c). It enables fast fill of vacated slots, might create short-lived contention. Recommend temporary throttle: set backfill rate limit to 0.1 for rack-a7.

alex: command to patch:```/infra config patch allocator --selector rack=a7 --set 'backfill_rate=0.1'``` also consider adding a routing override to divert new high-IO tenants off that rack:```routing.override.add --match 'io_type=high' --avoid rack-a7 --duration 30m```

infra-bot: [ALERT] rack-a7 high_tail_latency 2026-03-23T01:24:10Z -> suggested_actions=[throttle_backfill, quarantine_noisy_tenant, routing_diversion]

brynn: I can run the throttle now and spin a canary quarantine for the suspected tenant T-2330. cost tradeoff: quarantining into fractional-dedicated ~ $9/hr. worth it if SLOs protected.

chen: also propose adding a lightweight eBPF nic policer on that rack to clamp small-packet bursts:```kubectl -n infra apply -f eBPF-policer-rack-a7.yaml``` reduces PCIe interrupt storms without changing allocator heuristics.

alex: run both: throttle backfill + eBPF policer + soft-quarantine T-2330 for 20m. monitor 95/99. If improves, we'll open MR to add a canary toggle for backfill_rate per-rack.

brynn: executing now. will report metrics in 5m. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: [ACTION] applied allocator patch to selector rack=a7 2026-03-23T01:29:05Z

brynn: metrics look better at 1m post-change, 95th down ~70ms. keeping quarantine for 20m.

chen: filing follow-ups: 1) revert plan for b9a1c if regression confirmed, 2) add unit test simulating bursty small alloc pattern, 3) add rack-scoped backfill guard in allocator config docs.

alex: thanks. logging incident cost (~$3 for quarantine window). tagging infra and allocator teams for PM. closing thread after 20m unless it flares up.
